review_type: independent source-only review of minimal CI harness fix

source.diff_scope: 35 insertions and 3 deletions in one test file; no app, course content, core, packaging or native change.

failed_ci.failure: learning-only save needs review and confirmation, hides no form acceptance en: expected non-null Complete.onPressed, actual null.
failed_ci.bounded_observations: App 726 passed/1 failed; engine 176 passed. Retained job receipt records successful iOS no-codesign and Android unsigned code-path build jobs. Those successes do not turn the failed overall run into acceptance.

diagnosis.conclusion: The proposed readiness-race diagnosis is supported by source, but the retained terminal failure alone does not identify the exact missed or premature interaction.
diagnosis.old_test_gap: The old test used one settleIo call (8 real 5ms waits with widget pumps) before scrolling/tapping Practised, without asserting that its onPressed was enabled or that the action saved. Its later journal.load() waited for admitted IO but did not prove that a practice save had been admitted. It also tapped the whole confirmation tile without checking that confirmation was enabled or became true.
product_evidence: lib/app/calisthenics_course_screen.dart:144–161: reload keeps store null until loader and readStore/markSeen IO complete.
lib/app/calisthenics_course_screen.dart:814–820: Practised.onPressed is null when store is null or saving.
lib/app/calisthenics_course_screen.dart:835–840: confirmation onChanged is null while store is null or saving.
lib/app/calisthenics_course_screen.dart:852–860: Complete remains disabled without both confirmation and practice, and while storage is unavailable/saving.
diagnosis.causal_limit: A null Complete callback after the old checkbox step could also result from a missed/disabled confirmation or unfinished saving. The patch verifies all relevant boundaries instead of claiming one uninstrumented interleaving was proven.

patch_review.assessment: awaitUi checks the actual enabled UI state, pumps real-IO continuations for at most100 settleIo rounds and fails explicitly if readiness never arrives. It does not invoke callbacks directly, retry the save click or skip the test.
The real Practised button is ensured visible, settled, hit-tested, then tapped once.
A real journal read must show practiceCount1, state practised and completedCount0. Complete is still asserted disabled before confirmation. No direct store mutation is added by the test.
The test waits for CheckboxListTile.onChanged, selects the actual descendant Checkbox, ensures visibility, settles, hit-tests, taps once and verifies the tile value is true.

Disabled-before expectations and enabled-after expectation are retained. After the real Complete tap, the saved practiceCount1, selfReportedComplete state, completedCount1, next lesson, absence of physical preparation/answer acceptance and empty unrelated handling course are still checked. Both EN and TR execute the same flow.
No product completion gate, preparation rule, physical-course two-report rule, account boundary, storage implementation, camera release closure, curriculum or pin changes.

validation_at_review.first_targeted_log: ci-fix-targeted.txt ends +19 All tests passed; this predates the last visibility/state assertions according to the parent.
validation_at_review.final_targeted_log_at_first_read: ci-fix-targeted-final.txt was still in progress at +17; no final-green claim inferred from that partial log.
validation_at_review.required_next_gate: Parent must retain final targeted/analyzer outcome for this exact file hash, then obtain a new terminal PR CI result and final-main CI as required. The original failed CI run remains evidence and is not replaced by a local source review.

remaining_risks: Hosted-runner readiness is bounded to100 settleIo rounds (about4seconds real-delay budget plus work). An environment that exceeds the bound still fails diagnostically; this review does not prove flakiness is impossible.

No deterministic slow-markSeen failure fixture was added, so the precise first-run timing interleaving is not reproduced. The added state/readback assertions directly close the unverified test assumptions.
Other existing tests retain their own fixed-time fixture waits; they are outside this one failing test-only patch.
